blurb: School is back in session! Bring the whole family to the Botanical Gardens while kids 12 and under are free for the entire month of September! Ease back into the school year while relaxing and unwinding inside our plant-iful conservatory. Every Saturday during Growing Back to School, join us from 10am-1pm and complete a special Seed Planting activity!
